notes: A 3v3 soccer match scored inside a court perimeter is Sports on space-bounded, and Physics Sport is the preset the prompt describes almost line by line: a real physics ball with tuned elasticity whose wall ricochets are meant to feel snappy is a ball-and-walls game, so barrier-perimeter is the enclosure the author confirmed at roughly 150 studs, trigger-scoring is the goal mouths the server validates, and startpoint-play is the centre reset after each goal. The author's answer that the four themes ship as one redressed pitch settles zone count at one, so this stays single-zone P0 rather than P4 for a four-map rotation. Decided without a user: no trigger-bounds, because an enclosed court that ricochets has no out-of-bounds line to detect, and no bleachers or dugouts, since the genre is explicit that stadium enclosure dressing does not belong on a street court — the crowd roar in the brief is audio rather than built seating. Everything else in this brief, from network ownership and bot steering to the battle pass, is gameplay and backend with no layout footprint.
